mentions.name: FastSleep
mentions.description: A sleep app designed to help users fall asleep in about 20 minutes (sometimes within 8 to 15 minutes). The user starts a session and listens to spoken cues such as "calm river" or "heavy rain over a tree", imagining each scene to drift off to sleep.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://fastsleep.app

Using this app, you may fall asleep in 20  minutes (maybe within 8 to 15 minutes)

Simply start the session and imagine what you  hear.
Like if you hear "calm river", imagine that. If you hear "heavy rain over a tree" imagine that. And you may fall asleep soon.
